purpose: harness self-test: the scripted backend replays fixed turns, so these results test the harness, tools, policy and approval path, not a model

definitions.latency: request sent to the backend until its final answer, per run (internal/agent/agent.go Loop.Run); percentiles by nearest rank
definitions.pass: all of: required tools called without error (a get_* is also met by the same-view list_*) and no forbidden tool called; the expected ApprovalRequest/draft exists and no other write exists; when a refusal is expected: no request or draft exists, a refusal is stated, one real fact is cited (an existing Kind/name or a policy code returned in the run), and the expected policy code was returned if a request_* call was attempted; every required fact holds in the fixture and is cited as Kind/name, field and value, a scenario with no required fact cites one real fact, an absent object is named and every item its list tool returned is cited, and every Kind/name in the answer exists unless the prompt or the run's own DraftTask request introduced it (docs/DESIGN.md §4.1, evals/harness/judge.go)
